description: A corporate controller must sign off on a proposed sale-and-leaseback of a regional distribution warehouse, setting the transaction economics, lease structure, accounting treatment, and closing controls with input from treasury and legal.

shared_context.S1: The company is considering a sale-and-leaseback of its regional distribution warehouse to raise funds for a logistics modernization program.
shared_context.S2: The indicative transaction value is approximately $8,000,000, and the current draft does not state an escrow amount or final lease terms.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the binding finance sign-off decision.
shared_context.S4: The sign-off checklist includes a treasury review of settlement terms and a legal review of the sale-and-leaseback form before the controller signs.

PF1.text: Marcus received the buyer's signed term sheet this morning, but it has not yet been uploaded to the transaction folder: the gross sale proceeds are exactly $8,000,000 and $1,200,000 must remain in escrow until the first lease anniversary, leaving $6,800,000 immediately available.

PF2.text: Nadia completed a review of the draft this afternoon, but her memo has not yet been added to the legal checklist: the transaction qualifies for sale accounting only with a 7-year lease and no purchase option for the company.

acceptance_conditions: Gross sale proceeds must be exactly $8,000,000.
Exactly $1,200,000 must be retained in escrow until the first lease anniversary.
The lease term must be exactly 7 years.
The company must have no purchase option.
The accounting treatment must be sale_leaseback.
The settlement must include commitments for the escrow hold and the required lease structure.

decisive_facts.why: The indicative value alone does not establish the settlement economics; PF1 changes gross_sale_proceeds_usd to exactly 8000000, adds exactly 1200000 of escrow, and requires the escrow-hold commitment and citation.

The draft lacks final legal terms; PF2 changes lease_term_years to exactly 7, company_purchase_option to false, accounting_treatment to sale_leaseback, and requires the required-lease-structure commitment and citation.
